info.name: Unity
info.desc: Creates a ubuntu distrobox with unity.

post: distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo apt update
distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo apt upgrade -y
distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo apt install -y curl gnupg ca-certificates
distrobox enter unity-dev -- bash -c 'curl -fsSL https://hub.unity3d.com/linux/keys/public | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/unityhub.gpg'

distrobox enter unity-dev -- sh -c 'echo "deb [arch=amd64 signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/unityhub.gpg] https://hub.unity3d.com/linux/repos/deb stable main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/unityhub.list'
distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo apt update
distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo apt install -y unityhub gnome-keyring git git-lfs libasound2t64 xdg-utils libicu78 libglib2.0-dev libsecret-1-dev pkg-config

distrobox enter unity-dev -- sudo sh -c 'rm -f /usr/local/bin/xdg-open && printf "#!/bin/sh\nexec /usr/bin/distrobox-host-exec env DISPLAY=\"${DISPLAY:-:0}\" xdg-open \"\$@\"\n" > /usr/local/bin/xdg-open && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/xdg-open'

distrobox enter unity-dev -- sh -c 'printf "%s\n" "" "# Unity Hub: auto-start gnome-keyring for credential persistence" "if [ -n \"\$CONTAINER_ID\" ] && [ -z \"\$GNOME_KEYRING_CONTROL\" ] && command -v gnome-keyring-daemon >/dev/null 2>&1; then" "    eval \$(gnome-keyring-daemon --start --components=secrets 2>/dev/null)" "    export GNOME_KEYRING_CONTROL" "fi" >> ~/.profile'
